nodes.label: Accessibility Diff (Regression Check)
nodes.rationale: Diff a live page's a11y violations against a baseline. Stash mode (uncommitted changes) or branch mode. Reports new violations introduced, ones fixed, and pre-existing count. Locate; don't fix.

nodes.label: Stash Mode Baseline
nodes.rationale: Default mode: stash uncommitted changes, scan baseline, restore working tree, scan again, compare snapshots. Warns user before stashing; working tree fully restored.

nodes.label: Branch Mode Baseline
nodes.rationale: Compare against a branch: checkout branch to capture baseline, then restore. CLI opens fresh tab each run; use --wait-for as rebuild gate for slow builds.
